purpose: Minimal replaceable private HOT substrate for Primary Chat. Durable coordination authority remains GitHub/CURRENT; browser local outbox is the first durable acknowledgement.

tables.name: prometeo_primary_hot_requests_v1
tables.purpose: short-lived private request/outbox server copy and delivery correlation

browser_flow: save exact message + stable request_id locally before any network dependency
POST action=submit to HOT edge with workspace bearer secret
POST sanitized wake envelope + wake_token to Vercel bridge
Vercel verifies wake_token with HOT edge and writes one sanitized derived job into existing GitHub portfolio
existing allocator/PIN/claim authority claims the job
claimed worker reads the private request from the connected Supabase project using private_packet_lookup
worker writes durable RETURN + sanitized Primary Chat response to GitHub

failure_mode.hot_backend_down: browser remains LOCAL_DURABLE; circuit breaker suspends retry storm; GitHub-native work continues
failure_mode.vercel_down: request remains LOCAL_DURABLE/HOT_STORED and retries same request_id
failure_mode.github_write_down: HOT row remains STORED; no queued claim is fabricated
failure_mode.worker_capacity_zero: GitHub job remains READY; human action is only generic WC capacity refill

deployment_gate: create a fresh Supabase project after explicit org/cost confirmation
apply only private-hot schema, not historical Prometeo migrations
set Vercel PROMETEO_PRIMARY_HOT_ENDPOINT to the fresh function URL
switch browser ingress endpoint via one public config constant
run one real E2E before considering old Supabase non-critical
